searchText: I’d be curious to see if there are any discrepancies between benchmarks — I would expect so since Golang threads are different to “OS provided threads” but not sure if the difference would be significant Also if the gas pricing assumes multiple threads, then we’d need to standardize on the amount of threads to tune the gas pricing too? This is not the right server for this, also please don't post on different channels I'm assuming "discrepencies" here means difference between a Go implementation and something that can instantiate threads directly like C? I'm not sure atm Also for small/medium sized inputs, there might be differences between the go runtime scheduler and the os scheduler for threads
